input.summary: Limit IBM's licence in Customer-owned Type I Materials to performing the Services and confirm Customer ownership of Content and data.
input.comment: [Playbook] We own Type I Materials, so IBM should not hold an irrevocable right to distribute them externally or let others do so; we have limited that licence to performing the Services and added a confirmation that Customer retains all rights in its Content and data.

ops.oldText: distribute (internally and externally) copies of, and prepare derivative works based on Type I Materials; and 2. the right to authorize others to do any of the same.
ops.newText: distribute internally copies of, and prepare derivative works based on, Type I Materials, in each case solely as necessary to perform the Services; and 2. the right to authorize its Subcontractors to do any of the same solely for that purpose.

ops.text: e. Customer retains all right, title and interest (including all intellectual property rights) in and to the Content, Customer Components and all Customer data, and nothing in this Agreement transfers or assigns any such rights to IBM.

input.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations on termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on exit; we need transition assistance and our data back in a usable format, with deletion certified afterwards.

ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return all Content and other Customer data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
